vague_terms.quote: The evidence is insufficient to determine that the technology results in an improvement in the net health outcome.
vague_terms.problem: Standard rationale phrase, not a testable condition.

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
Over 70% of the file is Description and References; the real policy is three lines
Cross-reference to another guideline occurs only in the update history
interesting_structures: Template for 'investigational for all indications' documents: one sentence plus rationale boilerplate
Coverage rule for a code lives in a different guideline (09-A0000-03)

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: A single always-NOT_MET leaf; the 'tree' is trivial, but a checker should recognise it as a no-coverage policy rather than looking for criteria.
